title: Reserve vocabulary in context
instructions: Choose the meaning that best fits each independent sentence. Complete all five before submitting the protected form.

parts.prompt: The team made a tentative booking because the competition date had not yet been confirmed. What does “tentative” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.B: The booking may change when the date is known.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Tentative means not definite or final.

parts.prompt: Clean water became scarce after the pipe broke, so each household received only one container. What does “scarce” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.B: Safety is not the stated issue.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Scarce means insufficient or difficult to obtain.

parts.prompt: Although four students wrote different sections, the editor made the final report coherent by connecting the ideas and removing contradictions. What does “coherent” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: Connections and removed contradictions create unity.
choice_rationales.D: Vocabulary level is not the focus.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Coherent describes ideas that fit together in an understandable way.

parts.prompt: Loose cables hindered the rescue team by slowing movement through the narrow corridor. What does “hindered” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: The cables do not provide direction.
choice_rationales.B: They make movement slower and harder.
choice_rationales.D: Surprise is not the effect described.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Hindered means made progress difficult or slow.

parts.prompt: Before publishing the figure, the reporter called the survey organiser to verify that it had been copied correctly. What does “verify” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: The call checks whether the figure is correct.
choice_rationales.B: The original figure is being checked.
choice_rationales.C: Accuracy, not drama, is the goal.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Verify means check or demonstrate that something is true or accurate.
